Title: Matchbox Launches New Mercedes-Benz Die-Cast Car to Celebrate the Reveal of the All-New Electric G-Class
Text: ['Matchbox unveils the Matchbox Mercedes-Benz G 580 with EQ Technology premium die-cast car made with recycled metal and ISCC-certified plastic', 'EL SEGUNDO, Calif., April 30, 2024--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Today, Mattel, Inc. (NASDAQ: MAT) announced the Matchbox® Mercedes-Benz G 580 with EQ Technology die-cast car. The new die-cast vehicle was created to celebrate the iconic Mercedes-Benz G-Class and the recent reveal of its all-new electric model. Now Matchbox has unveiled its realistic and highly detailed model for fans to enjoy. The premium die-cast car features recycled metal and a minimum of 81% ISCC-certified plastic (mass balance approach*), highlighting how Matchbox is evolving its product offerings.', 'The Matchbox exclusive 1:64th scale replica die-cast features true to life details that embody the spirit of the iconic G-Class. The Matchbox Mercedes-Benz G 580 with EQ Technology comes in a beautiful MANUFAKTUR south seas blue magno with black interior. It’s made with 99.5% recycled metal, features one-of-a-kind packaging with textured paper and a base that attaches to the lid for a unique home display for car enthusiasts and collectors to enjoy. Matchbox stayed true to its commitment to using more sustainable materials while also providing fans with premium materials that feel authentic to the Mercedes-Benz all-new electric G-Class.', '"We\'re thrilled to be celebrating an iconic brand like Mercedes-Benz, which has continued to break boundaries in the electric vehicle space culminating in this momentous release of the first Mercedes-Benz all-new electric G-Class," said Roberto Stanichi, Global Head of Vehicles at Mattel. "We can’t think of a better way to mark the occasion than with the exclusive Matchbox die-cast release. We can drive toward a better future together as we stay committed to using more sustainable materials while simultaneously bringing fans realistic replicas of their favorite cars."', 'The Matchbox Mercedes-Benz all-new G-Class die-cast car expands upon Matchbox’s Driving Toward a Better Future campaign, introduced in 2022. This initiative champions greener play experiences by integrating electric vehicles in its product range, aligning with its goal to achieve 100% recycled, recyclable, or bio-based plastics in both toys and packaging by 2030.', '"We are very pleased that our all-new Mercedes-Benz G 580 with EQ Technology, the electric model of our off-road icon, is making its way into the versatile model range of Matchbox cars. We are convinced that it will find its way to many enthusiasts — even outside the G-Fans community," said Michael Knöller, Head of the Off-Road Vehicles division and CEO of Mercedes-Benz G GmbH.', 'Later in the year, the Matchbox Mercedes-Benz all-new electric G-Class die-cast car will also be available in Matchbox’s Moving Parts Series, which features a MANUFAKTUR classic grey non-metallic and movable doors that provide added authenticity, realism, and drive storytelling. All Moving Parts vehicles are made using recycled metal and a minimum of 51% ISCC-certified plastic (mass balance approach*).', 'The Matchbox Mercedes-Benz all-new electric G-Class premium version will be available in limited quantities exclusively at MattelCreations.com for $29.99 SRP on April 30. The Matchbox Mercedes-Benz all-new electric G-Class die-cast Moving Parts Series will be available at retailers nationwide this fall for $2.99 SRP.', 'Visit mattel.com to learn more about Mattel’s sustainability goals or visit Matchbox to learn more about the brand’s sustainable efforts and products.', '* Mass balance approach refers to the process of combining bio- or plant-based or recycled materials with conventional fossil materials during the production process, resulting in a final product that combines both recycled and fossil-based virgin materials. For more information visit here.', 'About Mattel', 'Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie®, Hot Wheels®, Fisher-Price®, American Girl®, Thomas & Friends™, UNO®, Masters of the Universe®, Matchbox®, Monster High®, MEGA® and Polly Pocket®, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. Visit us at mattel.com.', 'The Mercedes-Benz Group®', "The Mercedes-Benz Group AG (former Daimler AG) is one of the world's most successful automotive companies. With Mercedes-Benz AG, we are one of the leading global suppliers of high-end passenger cars and premium vans. Mercedes-Benz Mobility AG offers financing, leasing, car subscription and car rental, fleet management, digital services for charging and payment, insurance brokerage, as well as innovative mobility services.", 'Sustainability News: MAT-SU', 'View source version on businesswire.com: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20240430517324/en/', 'Contacts', 'Mattel Media Contacts: Shawn Smith, shawn.smith@mattel.com Rachel Roy, rachel.roy@mattel.com', 'Mercedes-Benz Media Contact: Markus Nast, markus.nast@mercedes-benz.com']

Title: Toy industry is currently stuck in 'a weird spot': Expert
Text: ['Toy giants Hasbro (HAS) and Mattel (MAT) reported their first-quarter earnings revealing declines in year-over-year sales. As consumers get hit with higher prices for food and gas, more pressing economic concerns may be interfering with toy sales.', 'The Toy Book Editor-in-Chief and The Toy Insider Senior Editor James Zahn joins Wealth! to talk about the retail picture rising toy prices are painting for the broader US consumer.', '"The toy industry is in a weird spot right now because we\'re coming off of a couple of years with the pandemic. We had all of those sales booms that no one planned for, and then they started to dive down," Zahn explains. "That softness at the end of 2022 rolled into \'23, and now we\'re seeing it again coming out of the first quarter of \'24. The big things right now are that families are dealing with economic concerns. They\'re paying more for groceries. More for gas. The excitement at retail really isn\'t there because all of the newness hasn\'t come in yet. So we\'re still in kind of a wait-and-see until some of these new, exciting products start hitting towards the middle of the year. "', 'For more expert insight and the latest market action, click here to watch this full episode of Wealth!', 'This post was written by Nicholas Jacobino']

Title: Mattel to Bring Three Channels to Samsung TV Plus
Text: ['Barbie and Friends, Hot Wheels Action, and Mattel Jr. to mark Mattel’s first-ever FAST channels, enhancing Samsung TV Plus’ Family & Kids offering with content featuring iconic Mattel brands', 'EL SEGUNDO, Calif. & NEW YORK, April 25, 2024--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Mattel, Inc. Text: ['EL SEGUNDO, Calif., May 08, 2024--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Mattel, Inc. We look forward to the impact Karen will make to further inspire and engage our high-performing and collaborative workforce at Mattel."', 'Joining Mattel following 11 years with Yum! Brands, Ms. Ancira was most recently Chief People and Culture Officer, KFC, US and previously for KFC in Australia, Latin America, and the Caribbean. Title: Matchbox Launches New Mercedes-Benz Die-Cast Car to Celebrate the Reveal of the All-New Electric G-Class
Text: ['Matchbox unveils the Matchbox Mercedes-Benz G 580 with EQ Technology premium die-cast car made with recycled metal and ISCC-certified plastic', 'EL SEGUNDO, Calif., April 30, 2024--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Today, Mattel, Inc. (NASDAQ: MAT) announced the Matchbox® Mercedes-Benz G 580 with EQ Technology die-cast car. The new die-cast vehicle was created to celebrate the iconic Mercedes-Benz G-Class and the recent reveal of its all-new electric model. Now Matchbox has unveiled its realistic and highly detailed model for fans to enjoy. The premium die-cast car features recycled metal and a minimum of 81% ISCC-certified plastic (mass balance approach*), highlighting how Matchbox is evolving its product offerings.', 'The Matchbox exclusive 1:64th scale replica die-cast features true to life details that embody the spirit of the iconic G-Class. The Matchbox Mercedes-Benz G 580 with EQ Technology comes in a beautiful MANUFAKTUR south seas blue magno with black interior. It’s made with 99.5% recycled metal, features one-of-a-kind packaging with textured paper and a base that attaches to the lid for a unique home display for car enthusiasts and collectors to enjoy. Matchbox stayed true to its commitment to using more sustainable materials while also providing fans with premium materials that feel authentic to the Mercedes-Benz all-new electric G-Class.', '"We\'re thrilled to be celebrating an iconic brand like Mercedes-Benz, which has continued to break boundaries in the electric vehicle space culminating in this momentous release of the first Mercedes-Benz all-new electric G-Class," said Roberto Stanichi, Global Head of Vehicles at Mattel. "We can’t think of a better way to mark the occasion than with the exclusive Matchbox die-cast release. We can drive toward a better future together as we stay committed to using more sustainable materials while simultaneously bringing fans realistic replicas of their favorite cars."', 'The Matchbox Mercedes-Benz all-new G-Class die-cast car expands upon Matchbox’s Driving Toward a Better Future campaign, introduced in 2022. This initiative champions greener play experiences by integrating electric vehicles in its product range, aligning with its goal to achieve 100% recycled, recyclable, or bio-based plastics in both toys and packaging by 2030.', '"We are very pleased that our all-new Mercedes-Benz G 580 with EQ Technology, the electric model of our off-road icon, is making its way into the versatile model range of Matchbox cars. We are convinced that it will find its way to many enthusiasts — even outside the G-Fans community," said Michael Knöller, Head of the Off-Road Vehicles division and CEO of Mercedes-Benz G GmbH.', 'Later in the year, the Matchbox Mercedes-Benz all-new electric G-Class die-cast car will also be available in Matchbox’s Moving Parts Series, which features a MANUFAKTUR classic grey non-metallic and movable doors that provide added authenticity, realism, and drive storytelling. All Moving Parts vehicles are made using recycled metal and a minimum of 51% ISCC-certified plastic (mass balance approach*).', 'The Matchbox Mercedes-Benz all-new electric G-Class premium version will be available in limited quantities exclusively at MattelCreations.com for $29.99 SRP on April 30. The Matchbox Mercedes-Benz all-new electric G-Class die-cast Moving Parts Series will be available at retailers nationwide this fall for $2.99 SRP.', 'Visit mattel.com to learn more about Mattel’s sustainability goals or visit Matchbox to learn more about the brand’s sustainable efforts and products.', '* Mass balance approach refers to the process of combining bio- or plant-based or recycled materials with conventional fossil materials during the production process, resulting in a final product that combines both recycled and fossil-based virgin materials. For more information visit here.', 'About Mattel', 'Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie®, Hot Wheels®, Fisher-Price®, American Girl®, Thomas & Friends™, UNO®, Masters of the Universe®, Matchbox®, Monster High®, MEGA® and Polly Pocket®, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. Visit us at mattel.com.', 'The Mercedes-Benz Group®', "The Mercedes-Benz Group AG (former Daimler AG) is one of the world's most successful automotive companies. With Mercedes-Benz AG, we are one of the leading global suppliers of high-end passenger cars and premium vans. Mercedes-Benz Mobility AG offers financing, leasing, car subscription and car rental, fleet management, digital services for charging and payment, insurance brokerage, as well as innovative mobility services.", 'Sustainability News: MAT-SU', 'View source version on businesswire.com: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20240430517324/en/', 'Contacts', 'Mattel Media Contacts: Shawn Smith, shawn.smith@mattel.com Rachel Roy, rachel.roy@mattel.com', 'Mercedes-Benz Media Contact: Markus Nast, markus.nast@mercedes-benz.com']

Title: Toy industry is currently stuck in 'a weird spot': Expert
Text: ['Toy giants Hasbro (HAS) and Mattel (MAT) reported their first-quarter earnings revealing declines in year-over-year sales. As consumers get hit with higher prices for food and gas, more pressing economic concerns may be interfering with toy sales.', 'The Toy Book Editor-in-Chief and The Toy Insider Senior Editor James Zahn joins Wealth! to talk about the retail picture rising toy prices are painting for the broader US consumer.', '"The toy industry is in a weird spot right now because we\'re coming off of a couple of years with the pandemic. We had all of those sales booms that no one planned for, and then they started to dive down," Zahn explains. "That softness at the end of 2022 rolled into \'23, and now we\'re seeing it again coming out of the first quarter of \'24. The big things right now are that families are dealing with economic concerns. They\'re paying more for groceries. More for gas. The excitement at retail really isn\'t there because all of the newness hasn\'t come in yet. So we\'re still in kind of a wait-and-see until some of these new, exciting products start hitting towards the middle of the year. "', 'For more expert insight and the latest market action, click here to watch this full episode of Wealth!', 'This post was written by Nicholas Jacobino']

Title: Mattel Appoints Karen Ancira Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer
Text: ['EL SEGUNDO, Calif., May 08, 2024--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Mattel, Inc. (NASDAQ: MAT) announced today that Karen Ancira has been appointed Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer for the company, effective May 15, 2024. Ms. Ancira will report to Ynon Kreiz, Chairman and CEO of Mattel.', 'Mr. Kreiz said: "Karen is an exceptional leader with a proven track record of cultivating purpose-driven, values-based Human Resources organizations and programs for major consumer brands globally. We look forward to the impact Karen will make to further inspire and engage our high-performing and collaborative workforce at Mattel."', 'Joining Mattel following 11 years with Yum! Brands, Ms. Ancira was most recently Chief People and Culture Officer, KFC, US and previously for KFC in Australia, Latin America, and the Caribbean. She also held senior Human Resources roles for the brand in UK and Ireland. From 2005-2012, Ms. Ancira served in HR leadership positions at PepsiCo in Monterrey, Mexico, creating and overseeing HR programs across Mexico, Latin America, and the Caribbean.', "Ms. Ancira brings to Mattel strong expertise in building progressive workplace cultures, fostering organizational development and effectiveness, and spearheading DE&I initiatives. During her tenure at Yum! Brands, Ancira developed a global leadership and character-building program that was implemented across the entire Yum! Brands portfolio. She also led the end-to-end HR agenda for the employee base, led the US organization through a leadership transformation, achieved 100% parity in gender pay for the US, and was instrumental in crafting and launching the business's transformation strategy.", 'Ms. Ancira added: "Mattel’s iconic portfolio is matched only by its passionate and committed global workforce. I have long admired the values of the company and identify deeply with the purpose behind its brands, and its relevance and importance to society. It is an honor to join this world-class leadership team to lead and enhance Mattel’s thriving culture and develop new People and Culture programs to help everyone succeed in this next exciting chapter for the company."', 'Ms. Ancira holds a BA in Economics from the University of Monterrey in Mexico and received an MBA from EAE Business School in Madrid, Spain. She is a member of the Board of Directors of the Latino Leadership Institute. Title: Matchbox Launches New Mercedes-Benz Die-Cast Car to Celebrate the Reveal of the All-New Electric G-Class
Text: ['Matchbox unveils the Matchbox Mercedes-Benz G 580 with EQ Technology premium die-cast car made with recycled metal and ISCC-certified plastic', 'EL SEGUNDO, Calif., April 30, 2024--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Today, Mattel, Inc. (NASDAQ: MAT) announced the Matchbox® Mercedes-Benz G 580 with EQ Technology die-cast car. The new die-cast vehicle was created to celebrate the iconic Mercedes-Benz G-Class and the recent reveal of its all-new electric model. Now Matchbox has unveiled its realistic and highly detailed model for fans to enjoy. The premium die-cast car features recycled metal and a minimum of 81% ISCC-certified plastic (mass balance approach*), highlighting how Matchbox is evolving its product offerings.', 'The Matchbox exclusive 1:64th scale replica die-cast features true to life details that embody the spirit of the iconic G-Class. The Matchbox Mercedes-Benz G 580 with EQ Technology comes in a beautiful MANUFAKTUR south seas blue magno with black interior. It’s made with 99.5% recycled metal, features one-of-a-kind packaging with textured paper and a base that attaches to the lid for a unique home display for car enthusiasts and collectors to enjoy. Matchbox stayed true to its commitment to using more sustainable materials while also providing fans with premium materials that feel authentic to the Mercedes-Benz all-new electric G-Class.', '"We\'re thrilled to be celebrating an iconic brand like Mercedes-Benz, which has continued to break boundaries in the electric vehicle space culminating in this momentous release of the first Mercedes-Benz all-new electric G-Class," said Roberto Stanichi, Global Head of Vehicles at Mattel. "We can’t think of a better way to mark the occasion than with the exclusive Matchbox die-cast release. We can drive toward a better future together as we stay committed to using more sustainable materials while simultaneously bringing fans realistic replicas of their favorite cars."', 'The Matchbox Mercedes-Benz all-new G-Class die-cast car expands upon Matchbox’s Driving Toward a Better Future campaign, introduced in 2022. This initiative champions greener play experiences by integrating electric vehicles in its product range, aligning with its goal to achieve 100% recycled, recyclable, or bio-based plastics in both toys and packaging by 2030.', '"We are very pleased that our all-new Mercedes-Benz G 580 with EQ Technology, the electric model of our off-road icon, is making its way into the versatile model range of Matchbox cars. We are convinced that it will find its way to many enthusiasts — even outside the G-Fans community," said Michael Knöller, Head of the Off-Road Vehicles division and CEO of Mercedes-Benz G GmbH.', 'Later in the year, the Matchbox Mercedes-Benz all-new electric G-Class die-cast car will also be available in Matchbox’s Moving Parts Series, which features a MANUFAKTUR classic grey non-metallic and movable doors that provide added authenticity, realism, and drive storytelling. All Moving Parts vehicles are made using recycled metal and a minimum of 51% ISCC-certified plastic (mass balance approach*).', 'The Matchbox Mercedes-Benz all-new electric G-Class premium version will be available in limited quantities exclusively at MattelCreations.com for $29.99 SRP on April 30. The Matchbox Mercedes-Benz all-new electric G-Class die-cast Moving Parts Series will be available at retailers nationwide this fall for $2.99 SRP.', 'Visit mattel.com to learn more about Mattel’s sustainability goals or visit Matchbox to learn more about the brand’s sustainable efforts and products.', '* Mass balance approach refers to the process of combining bio- or plant-based or recycled materials with conventional fossil materials during the production process, resulting in a final product that combines both recycled and fossil-based virgin materials. For more information visit here.', 'About Mattel', 'Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie®, Hot Wheels®, Fisher-Price®, American Girl®, Thomas & Friends™, UNO®, Masters of the Universe®, Matchbox®, Monster High®, MEGA® and Polly Pocket®, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. Visit us at mattel.com.', 'The Mercedes-Benz Group®', "The Mercedes-Benz Group AG (former Daimler AG) is one of the world's most successful automotive companies. With Mercedes-Benz AG, we are one of the leading global suppliers of high-end passenger cars and premium vans. Mercedes-Benz Mobility AG offers financing, leasing, car subscription and car rental, fleet management, digital services for charging and payment, insurance brokerage, as well as innovative mobility services.", 'Sustainability News: MAT-SU', 'View source version on businesswire.com: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20240430517324/en/', 'Contacts', 'Mattel Media Contacts: Shawn Smith, shawn.smith@mattel.com Rachel Roy, rachel.roy@mattel.com', 'Mercedes-Benz Media Contact: Markus Nast, markus.nast@mercedes-benz.com']

Title: Toy industry is currently stuck in 'a weird spot': Expert
Text: ['Toy giants Hasbro (HAS) and Mattel (MAT) reported their first-quarter earnings revealing declines in year-over-year sales. As consumers get hit with higher prices for food and gas, more pressing economic concerns may be interfering with toy sales.', 'The Toy Book Editor-in-Chief and The Toy Insider Senior Editor James Zahn joins Wealth! to talk about the retail picture rising toy prices are painting for the broader US consumer.', '"The toy industry is in a weird spot right now because we\'re coming off of a couple of years with the pandemic. We had all of those sales booms that no one planned for, and then they started to dive down," Zahn explains. "That softness at the end of 2022 rolled into \'23, and now we\'re seeing it again coming out of the first quarter of \'24. The big things right now are that families are dealing with economic concerns. They\'re paying more for groceries. More for gas. The excitement at retail really isn\'t there because all of the newness hasn\'t come in yet. So we\'re still in kind of a wait-and-see until some of these new, exciting products start hitting towards the middle of the year. Title: Mattel Appoints Karen Ancira Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer
Text: ['EL SEGUNDO, Calif., May 08, 2024--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Mattel, Inc. (NASDAQ: MAT) announced today that Karen Ancira has been appointed Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer for the company, effective May 15, 2024. Ms. Ancira will report to Ynon Kreiz, Chairman and CEO of Mattel.', 'Mr. Kreiz said: "Karen is an exceptional leader with a proven track record of cultivating purpose-driven, values-based Human Resources organizations and programs for major consumer brands globally. We look forward to the impact Karen will make to further inspire and engage our high-performing and collaborative workforce at Mattel."', 'Joining Mattel following 11 years with Yum! Brands, Ms. Ancira was most recently Chief People and Culture Officer, KFC, US and previously for KFC in Australia, Latin America, and the Caribbean. She also held senior Human Resources roles for the brand in UK and Ireland. From 2005-2012, Ms. Ancira served in HR leadership positions at PepsiCo in Monterrey, Mexico, creating and overseeing HR programs across Mexico, Latin America, and the Caribbean.', "Ms. Ancira brings to Mattel strong expertise in building progressive workplace cultures, fostering organizational development and effectiveness, and spearheading DE&I initiatives. During her tenure at Yum! Brands, Ancira developed a global leadership and character-building program that was implemented across the entire Yum! Brands portfolio. She also led the end-to-end HR agenda for the employee base, led the US organization through a leadership transformation, achieved 100% parity in gender pay for the US, and was instrumental in crafting and launching the business's transformation strategy.", 'Ms. Ancira added: "Mattel’s iconic portfolio is matched only by its passionate and committed global workforce. I have long admired the values of the company and identify deeply with the purpose behind its brands, and its relevance and importance to society. It is an honor to join this world-class leadership team to lead and enhance Mattel’s thriving culture and develop new People and Culture programs to help everyone succeed in this next exciting chapter for the company."', 'Ms. Ancira holds a BA in Economics from the University of Monterrey in Mexico and received an MBA from EAE Business School in Madrid, Spain. Title: Matchbox Launches New Mercedes-Benz Die-Cast Car to Celebrate the Reveal of the All-New Electric G-Class
Text: ['Matchbox unveils the Matchbox Mercedes-Benz G 580 with EQ Technology premium die-cast car made with recycled metal and ISCC-certified plastic', 'EL SEGUNDO, Calif., April 30, 2024--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Today, Mattel, Inc. (NASDAQ: MAT) announced the Matchbox® Mercedes-Benz G 580 with EQ Technology die-cast car. The new die-cast vehicle was created to celebrate the iconic Mercedes-Benz G-Class and the recent reveal of its all-new electric model. Now Matchbox has unveiled its realistic and highly detailed model for fans to enjoy. The premium die-cast car features recycled metal and a minimum of 81% ISCC-certified plastic (mass balance approach*), highlighting how Matchbox is evolving its product offerings.', 'The Matchbox exclusive 1:64th scale replica die-cast features true to life details that embody the spirit of the iconic G-Class. The Matchbox Mercedes-Benz G 580 with EQ Technology comes in a beautiful MANUFAKTUR south seas blue magno with black interior. It’s made with 99.5% recycled metal, features one-of-a-kind packaging with textured paper and a base that attaches to the lid for a unique home display for car enthusiasts and collectors to enjoy. Matchbox stayed true to its commitment to using more sustainable materials while also providing fans with premium materials that feel authentic to the Mercedes-Benz all-new electric G-Class.', '"We\'re thrilled to be celebrating an iconic brand like Mercedes-Benz, which has continued to break boundaries in the electric vehicle space culminating in this momentous release of the first Mercedes-Benz all-new electric G-Class," said Roberto Stanichi, Global Head of Vehicles at Mattel. "We can’t think of a better way to mark the occasion than with the exclusive Matchbox die-cast release. We can drive toward a better future together as we stay committed to using more sustainable materials while simultaneously bringing fans realistic replicas of their favorite cars."', 'The Matchbox Mercedes-Benz all-new G-Class die-cast car expands upon Matchbox’s Driving Toward a Better Future campaign, introduced in 2022. This initiative champions greener play experiences by integrating electric vehicles in its product range, aligning with its goal to achieve 100% recycled, recyclable, or bio-based plastics in both toys and packaging by 2030.', '"We are very pleased that our all-new Mercedes-Benz G 580 with EQ Technology, the electric model of our off-road icon, is making its way into the versatile model range of Matchbox cars. We are convinced that it will find its way to many enthusiasts — even outside the G-Fans community," said Michael Knöller, Head of the Off-Road Vehicles division and CEO of Mercedes-Benz G GmbH.', 'Later in the year, the Matchbox Mercedes-Benz all-new electric G-Class die-cast car will also be available in Matchbox’s Moving Parts Series, which features a MANUFAKTUR classic grey non-metallic and movable doors that provide added authenticity, realism, and drive storytelling. All Moving Parts vehicles are made using recycled metal and a minimum of 51% ISCC-certified plastic (mass balance approach*).', 'The Matchbox Mercedes-Benz all-new electric G-Class premium version will be available in limited quantities exclusively at MattelCreations.com for $29.99 SRP on April 30. The Matchbox Mercedes-Benz all-new electric G-Class die-cast Moving Parts Series will be available at retailers nationwide this fall for $2.99 SRP.', 'Visit mattel.com to learn more about Mattel’s sustainability goals or visit Matchbox to learn more about the brand’s sustainable efforts and products.', '* Mass balance approach refers to the process of combining bio- or plant-based or recycled materials with conventional fossil materials during the production process, resulting in a final product that combines both recycled and fossil-based virgin materials. For more information visit here.', 'About Mattel', 'Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie®, Hot Wheels®, Fisher-Price®, American Girl®, Thomas & Friends™, UNO®, Masters of the Universe®, Matchbox®, Monster High®, MEGA® and Polly Pocket®, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. Visit us at mattel.com.', 'The Mercedes-Benz Group®', "The Mercedes-Benz Group AG (former Daimler AG) is one of the world's most successful automotive companies. With Mercedes-Benz AG, we are one of the leading global suppliers of high-end passenger cars and premium vans. Mercedes-Benz Mobility AG offers financing, leasing, car subscription and car rental, fleet management, digital services for charging and payment, insurance brokerage, as well as innovative mobility services.", 'Sustainability News: MAT-SU', 'View source version on businesswire.com: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20240430517324/en/', 'Contacts', 'Mattel Media Contacts: Shawn Smith, shawn.smith@mattel.com Rachel Roy, rachel.roy@mattel.com', 'Mercedes-Benz Media Contact: Markus Nast, markus.nast@mercedes-benz.com']

Title: Mattel Appoints Karen Ancira Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer
Text: ['EL SEGUNDO, Calif., May 08, 2024--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Mattel, Inc. (NASDAQ: MAT) announced today that Karen Ancira has been appointed Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer for the company, effective May 15, 2024. Ms. Ancira will report to Ynon Kreiz, Chairman and CEO of Mattel.', 'Mr. Kreiz said: "Karen is an exceptional leader with a proven track record of cultivating purpose-driven, values-based Human Resources organizations and programs for major consumer brands globally. We look forward to the impact Karen will make to further inspire and engage our high-performing and collaborative workforce at Mattel."', 'Joining Mattel following 11 years with Yum! Brands, Ms. Ancira was most recently Chief People and Culture Officer, KFC, US and previously for KFC in Australia, Latin America, and the Caribbean. From 2005-2012, Ms. Ancira served in HR leadership positions at PepsiCo in Monterrey, Mexico, creating and overseeing HR programs across Mexico, Latin America, and the Caribbean.', "Ms. Ancira brings to Mattel strong expertise in building progressive workplace cultures, fostering organizational development and effectiveness, and spearheading DE&I initiatives. During her tenure at Yum! Brands, Ancira developed a global leadership and character-building program that was implemented across the entire Yum! Brands portfolio. Title: Matchbox Launches New Mercedes-Benz Die-Cast Car to Celebrate the Reveal of the All-New Electric G-Class
Text: ['Matchbox unveils the Matchbox Mercedes-Benz G 580 with EQ Technology premium die-cast car made with recycled metal and ISCC-certified plastic', 'EL SEGUNDO, Calif., April 30, 2024--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Today, Mattel, Inc. (NASDAQ: MAT) announced the Matchbox® Mercedes-Benz G 580 with EQ Technology die-cast car. The new die-cast vehicle was created to celebrate the iconic Mercedes-Benz G-Class and the recent reveal of its all-new electric model. Now Matchbox has unveiled its realistic and highly detailed model for fans to enjoy. The premium die-cast car features recycled metal and a minimum of 81% ISCC-certified plastic (mass balance approach*), highlighting how Matchbox is evolving its product offerings.', 'The Matchbox exclusive 1:64th scale replica die-cast features true to life details that embody the spirit of the iconic G-Class. The Matchbox Mercedes-Benz G 580 with EQ Technology comes in a beautiful MANUFAKTUR south seas blue magno with black interior. It’s made with 99.5% recycled metal, features one-of-a-kind packaging with textured paper and a base that attaches to the lid for a unique home display for car enthusiasts and collectors to enjoy. Matchbox stayed true to its commitment to using more sustainable materials while also providing fans with premium materials that feel authentic to the Mercedes-Benz all-new electric G-Class.', '"We\'re thrilled to be celebrating an iconic brand like Mercedes-Benz, which has continued to break boundaries in the electric vehicle space culminating in this momentous release of the first Mercedes-Benz all-new electric G-Class," said Roberto Stanichi, Global Head of Vehicles at Mattel. "We can’t think of a better way to mark the occasion than with the exclusive Matchbox die-cast release. We can drive toward a better future together as we stay committed to using more sustainable materials while simultaneously bringing fans realistic replicas of their favorite cars."', 'The Matchbox Mercedes-Benz all-new G-Class die-cast car expands upon Matchbox’s Driving Toward a Better Future campaign, introduced in 2022. This initiative champions greener play experiences by integrating electric vehicles in its product range, aligning with its goal to achieve 100% recycled, recyclable, or bio-based plastics in both toys and packaging by 2030.', '"We are very pleased that our all-new Mercedes-Benz G 580 with EQ Technology, the electric model of our off-road icon, is making its way into the versatile model range of Matchbox cars. We are convinced that it will find its way to many enthusiasts — even outside the G-Fans community," said Michael Knöller, Head of the Off-Road Vehicles division and CEO of Mercedes-Benz G GmbH.', 'Later in the year, the Matchbox Mercedes-Benz all-new electric G-Class die-cast car will also be available in Matchbox’s Moving Parts Series, which features a MANUFAKTUR classic grey non-metallic and movable doors that provide added authenticity, realism, and drive storytelling. All Moving Parts vehicles are made using recycled metal and a minimum of 51% ISCC-certified plastic (mass balance approach*).', 'The Matchbox Mercedes-Benz all-new electric G-Class premium version will be available in limited quantities exclusively at MattelCreations.com for $29.99 SRP on April 30. The Matchbox Mercedes-Benz all-new electric G-Class die-cast Moving Parts Series will be available at retailers nationwide this fall for $2.99 SRP.', 'Visit mattel.com to learn more about Mattel’s sustainability goals or visit Matchbox to learn more about the brand’s sustainable efforts and products.', '* Mass balance approach refers to the process of combining bio- or plant-based or recycled materials with conventional fossil materials during the production process, resulting in a final product that combines both recycled and fossil-based virgin materials. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie®, Hot Wheels®, Fisher-Price®, American Girl®, Thomas & Friends™, UNO®, Masters of the Universe®, Matchbox®, Monster High®, MEGA® and Polly Pocket®, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Visit us at mattel.com.', 'The Mercedes-Benz Group®', "The Mercedes-Benz Group AG (former Daimler AG) is one of the world's most successful automotive companies. With Mercedes-Benz AG, we are one of the leading global suppliers of high-end passenger cars and premium vans. From 2005-2012, Ms. Ancira served in HR leadership positions at PepsiCo in Monterrey, Mexico, creating and overseeing HR programs across Mexico, Latin America, and the Caribbean.', "Ms. Ancira brings to Mattel strong expertise in building progressive workplace cultures, fostering organizational development and effectiveness, and spearheading DE&I initiatives. During her tenure at Yum! Brands, Ancira developed a global leadership and character-building program that was implemented across the entire Yum! Brands portfolio. It is an honor to join this world-class leadership team to lead and enhance Mattel’s thriving culture and develop new People and Culture programs to help everyone succeed in this next exciting chapter for the company."', 'Ms. Ancira holds a BA in Economics from the University of Monterrey in Mexico and received an MBA from EAE Business School in Madrid, Spain. Title: Matchbox Launches New Mercedes-Benz Die-Cast Car to Celebrate the Reveal of the All-New Electric G-Class
Text: ['Matchbox unveils the Matchbox Mercedes-Benz G 580 with EQ Technology premium die-cast car made with recycled metal and ISCC-certified plastic', 'EL SEGUNDO, Calif., April 30, 2024--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Today, Mattel, Inc. (NASDAQ: MAT) announced the Matchbox® Mercedes-Benz G 580 with EQ Technology die-cast car. The new die-cast vehicle was created to celebrate the iconic Mercedes-Benz G-Class and the recent reveal of its all-new electric model. Now Matchbox has unveiled its realistic and highly detailed model for fans to enjoy. The premium die-cast car features recycled metal and a minimum of 81% ISCC-certified plastic (mass balance approach*), highlighting how Matchbox is evolving its product offerings.', 'The Matchbox exclusive 1:64th scale replica die-cast features true to life details that embody the spirit of the iconic G-Class. The Matchbox Mercedes-Benz G 580 with EQ Technology comes in a beautiful MANUFAKTUR south seas blue magno with black interior. It’s made with 99.5% recycled metal, features one-of-a-kind packaging with textured paper and a base that attaches to the lid for a unique home display for car enthusiasts and collectors to enjoy. Matchbox stayed true to its commitment to using more sustainable materials while also providing fans with premium materials that feel authentic to the Mercedes-Benz all-new electric G-Class.', '"We\'re thrilled to be celebrating an iconic brand like Mercedes-Benz, which has continued to break boundaries in the electric vehicle space culminating in this momentous release of the first Mercedes-Benz all-new electric G-Class," said Roberto Stanichi, Global Head of Vehicles at Mattel. "We can’t think of a better way to mark the occasion than with the exclusive Matchbox die-cast release. We can drive toward a better future together as we stay committed to using more sustainable materials while simultaneously bringing fans realistic replicas of their favorite cars."', 'The Matchbox Mercedes-Benz all-new G-Class die-cast car expands upon Matchbox’s Driving Toward a Better Future campaign, introduced in 2022. This initiative champions greener play experiences by integrating electric vehicles in its product range, aligning with its goal to achieve 100% recycled, recyclable, or bio-based plastics in both toys and packaging by 2030.', '"We are very pleased that our all-new Mercedes-Benz G 580 with EQ Technology, the electric model of our off-road icon, is making its way into the versatile model range of Matchbox cars. We are convinced that it will find its way to many enthusiasts — even outside the G-Fans community," said Michael Knöller, Head of the Off-Road Vehicles division and CEO of Mercedes-Benz G GmbH.', 'Later in the year, the Matchbox Mercedes-Benz all-new electric G-Class die-cast car will also be available in Matchbox’s Moving Parts Series, which features a MANUFAKTUR classic grey non-metallic and movable doors that provide added authenticity, realism, and drive storytelling. All Moving Parts vehicles are made using recycled metal and a minimum of 51% ISCC-certified plastic (mass balance approach*).', 'The Matchbox Mercedes-Benz all-new electric G-Class premium version will be available in limited quantities exclusively at MattelCreations.com for $29.99 SRP on April 30. The Matchbox Mercedes-Benz all-new electric G-Class die-cast Moving Parts Series will be available at retailers nationwide this fall for $2.99 SRP.', 'Visit mattel.com to learn more about Mattel’s sustainability goals or visit Matchbox to learn more about the brand’s sustainable efforts and products.', '* Mass balance approach refers to the process of combining bio- or plant-based or recycled materials with conventional fossil materials during the production process, resulting in a final product that combines both recycled and fossil-based virgin materials. For more information visit here.', 'About Mattel', 'Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie®, Hot Wheels®, Fisher-Price®, American Girl®, Thomas & Friends™, UNO®, Masters of the Universe®, Matchbox®, Monster High®, MEGA® and Polly Pocket®, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. Visit us at mattel.com.', 'The Mercedes-Benz Group®', "The Mercedes-Benz Group AG (former Daimler AG) is one of the world's most successful automotive companies. With Mercedes-Benz AG, we are one of the leading global suppliers of high-end passenger cars and premium vans. Mercedes-Benz Mobility AG offers financing, leasing, car subscription and car rental, fleet management, digital services for charging and payment, insurance brokerage, as well as innovative mobility services.", 'Sustainability News: MAT-SU', 'View source version on businesswire.com: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20240430517324/en/', 'Contacts', 'Mattel Media Contacts: Shawn Smith, shawn.smith@mattel.com Rachel Roy, rachel.roy@mattel.com', 'Mercedes-Benz Media Contact: Markus Nast, markus.nast@mercedes-benz.com']

Title: Three American Girl Classics Are Back! Kirsten™, Addy™, and Josefina™ Return to Flagship Historical Line With Original Tribute Collections
Text: ['The brand’s grooviest girl — 1970s-era character Julie Albright™— also shines bright with all-new product collection and stories', 'MIDDLETON, Wis., May 13, 2024--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Today, American Girl, a cornerstone in the Mattel (NASDAQ: MAT) portfolio of purposeful brands, announced the re-release of three classic historical characters — Kirsten Larson™, Addy Walker™, and Josefina Montoya™— with special tribute collections that harken back to the brand’s roots. Kirsten, Addy, and Josefina (originally debuting in 1986, 1993, and 1997 respectively) remain fan-favorite characters that have inspired generations with their timeless stories that celebrate family and friendship, resilience in the face of change, and hope for the future. Now, these enduring characters are set to stir up a wave of nostalgia and inspire a legion of new fans with the debut of these three keepsake collections, featuring their original fashions and accessories, along with updated stories to bring the characters’ worlds to life in a fresh, relevant way.', '"As we look back on American Girl’s rich legacy, it’s our beloved historical characters and their powerful stories that have transcended the test of time—instilling in generations of girls and women an understanding of their own important place in the world," says Jamie Cygielman, General Manager of American Girl. "Through the return of such classics as Kirsten, Addy, and Josefina, along with new product and story offerings for our other timeless characters, like 1970s Julie Albright, we’re excited to continue engaging and inspiring American Girl fans of all ages for years to come."', 'The new throwback collections feature a signature 18-inch Kirsten, Addy, and Josefina doll that comes dressed in the character’s original debut outfit, along with her authentic introductory accessories. Arriving in a retro American Girls Collection™ box, each set also includes the character’s first paperback book in the series with vintage cover design and updated language, imagery, and resources to resonate with today’s readers. And, to celebrate birthdays through the decades, American Girl is also reissuing Kirsten, Addy, and Josefina’s original birthday party dresses and accompanying Happy Birthday books with original cover designs.', 'Additionally, for fans of American Girl’s beloved 1970s historical character, Julie Albright, there’s a new assortment of flower-power fun, including a totally retro school outfit and floral metal lunch box; a funky floral jumpsuit; a record player set with doll-sized records that play ’70s-inspired songs; and a fun skating outfit with lace-on shoe roller skates that really roll. In addition, American Girl Publishing released a new illustrated journal to tell Julie’s story of growing up in 1974 San Francisco. Told from the character’s perspective, Julie’s new journal format is a historical collection first, featuring full-color doodles and non-fiction back matter with details related to the story and era. The new illustrated journal will now come with the 18-inch Julie™ doll and is also available wherever books are sold. Additional illustrated journals and diaries for other historical characters are slated to debut in 2025 and beyond.', 'To further expand its storytelling, American Girl is also partnering with IDW Publishing to introduce a first-ever graphic-novel mystery series based on the popular historical characters. The first mystery—Julie and the Blue Guitar—is debuting this June, with a second book based on the late-’90s duo, Isabel and Nicki, releasing in spring 2025. More graphic mystery novels are planned to follow and will be available wherever books are sold. To support parents and educators, American Girl is also updating its free, downloadable discussion and teaching guides based on the historical character series in June 2024 at americangirl.com.', 'Fans can celebrate their favorite American Girl historical characters in person or online by:', 'visiting American Girl retail stores to enjoy a special Historical Character Birthday Teatime or Julie’s Groovy Painting Party at the signature cafes; book an appointment for a classic ’do at the Dolled Up Salon; explore new product and story collections, and more.', 'checking out American Girl’s TikTok channel and Instagram for fun historical character-themed TikTok trends, in-feed posts and stories, promotions, and book content.', 'watching new Julie-inspired videos starting in late May on American Girl’s popular YouTube and YouTube Kids Channel.', 'touring Addy, Josefina, Kirsten, and Julie’s rooms and exploring all the AG characters at the free Virtual Museum, and', 'learning more character background details on American Girl Wiki.', 'American Girl’s new tribute collections for Kirsten, Addy, and Josefina, plus the new Julie products and stories, are available now at americangirl.com and American Girl retail stores nationwide.', 'ABOUT AMERICAN GIRL', 'American Girl is a premium brand for girls and a wholly-owned subsidiary of Mattel, Inc. (NASDAQ: MAT, www.mattel.com), a leading global toy company and owner of one of the strongest portfolios of children’s and family entertainment franchises in the world. American Girl offers an inspiring world of dolls, content, and experiences that nourish a girl’s spirit and help develop her strength of character. Best-selling lines include Truly Me™, Girl of the Year™, Bitty Baby®, WellieWishers™, Create Your Own™, and American Girl’s classic historical characters. The company sells products through its award-winning catalogue, on americangirl.com, in its proprietary U.S. experiential retail stores, as well as at specialty retailers nationwide. By inspiring girls to be their best, American Girl has earned the loyalty of millions and the praise and trust of parents and educators. Connect with American Girl on: YouTube; Facebook; Instagram; TikTok; Pinterest', 'MAT-AG', 'View source version on businesswire.com: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20240513975758/en/', 'Contacts', 'Laura Mays, Weber Shandwick, lmays@webershandwick.com Julie Parks, American Girl: julie.parks@americangirl.com']

Title: Mattel Appoints Karen Ancira Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer
Text: ['EL SEGUNDO, Calif., May 08, 2024--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Mattel, Inc. (NASDAQ: MAT) announced today that Karen Ancira has been appointed Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer for the company, effective May 15, 2024. Ms. Ancira will report to Ynon Kreiz, Chairman and CEO of Mattel.', 'Mr. Kreiz said: "Karen is an exceptional leader with a proven track record of cultivating purpose-driven, values-based Human Resources organizations and programs for major consumer brands globally. We look forward to the impact Karen will make to further inspire and engage our high-performing and collaborative workforce at Mattel."', 'Joining Mattel following 11 years with Yum! Brands, Ms. Ancira was most recently Chief People and Culture Officer, KFC, US and previously for KFC in Australia, Latin America, and the Caribbean. She also held senior Human Resources roles for the brand in UK and Ireland. From 2005-2012, Ms. Ancira served in HR leadership positions at PepsiCo in Monterrey, Mexico, creating and overseeing HR programs across Mexico, Latin America, and the Caribbean.', "Ms. Ancira brings to Mattel strong expertise in building progressive workplace cultures, fostering organizational development and effectiveness, and spearheading DE&I initiatives. During her tenure at Yum! Brands, Ancira developed a global leadership and character-building program that was implemented across the entire Yum! Brands portfolio. She also led the end-to-end HR agenda for the employee base, led the US organization through a leadership transformation, achieved 100% parity in gender pay for the US, and was instrumental in crafting and launching the business's transformation strategy.", 'Ms. Ancira added: "Mattel’s iconic portfolio is matched only by its passionate and committed global workforce. I have long admired the values of the company and identify deeply with the purpose behind its brands, and its relevance and importance to society. It is an honor to join this world-class leadership team to lead and enhance Mattel’s thriving culture and develop new People and Culture programs to help everyone succeed in this next exciting chapter for the company."', 'Ms. Ancira holds a BA in Economics from the University of Monterrey in Mexico and received an MBA from EAE Business School in Madrid, Spain. Title: Three American Girl Classics Are Back! Kirsten™, Addy™, and Josefina™ Return to Flagship Historical Line With Original Tribute Collections
Text: ['The brand’s grooviest girl — 1970s-era character Julie Albright™— also shines bright with all-new product collection and stories', 'MIDDLETON, Wis., May 13, 2024--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Today, American Girl, a cornerstone in the Mattel (NASDAQ: MAT) portfolio of purposeful brands, announced the re-release of three classic historical characters — Kirsten Larson™, Addy Walker™, and Josefina Montoya™— with special tribute collections that harken back to the brand’s roots. Kirsten, Addy, and Josefina (originally debuting in 1986, 1993, and 1997 respectively) remain fan-favorite characters that have inspired generations with their timeless stories that celebrate family and friendship, resilience in the face of change, and hope for the future. Now, these enduring characters are set to stir up a wave of nostalgia and inspire a legion of new fans with the debut of these three keepsake collections, featuring their original fashions and accessories, along with updated stories to bring the characters’ worlds to life in a fresh, relevant way.', '"As we look back on American Girl’s rich legacy, it’s our beloved historical characters and their powerful stories that have transcended the test of time—instilling in generations of girls and women an understanding of their own important place in the world," says Jamie Cygielman, General Manager of American Girl. "Through the return of such classics as Kirsten, Addy, and Josefina, along with new product and story offerings for our other timeless characters, like 1970s Julie Albright, we’re excited to continue engaging and inspiring American Girl fans of all ages for years to come."', 'The new throwback collections feature a signature 18-inch Kirsten, Addy, and Josefina doll that comes dressed in the character’s original debut outfit, along with her authentic introductory accessories. Arriving in a retro American Girls Collection™ box, each set also includes the character’s first paperback book in the series with vintage cover design and updated language, imagery, and resources to resonate with today’s readers. And, to celebrate birthdays through the decades, American Girl is also reissuing Kirsten, Addy, and Josefina’s original birthday party dresses and accompanying Happy Birthday books with original cover designs.', 'Additionally, for fans of American Girl’s beloved 1970s historical character, Julie Albright, there’s a new assortment of flower-power fun, including a totally retro school outfit and floral metal lunch box; a funky floral jumpsuit; a record player set with doll-sized records that play ’70s-inspired songs; and a fun skating outfit with lace-on shoe roller skates that really roll. In addition, American Girl Publishing released a new illustrated journal to tell Julie’s story of growing up in 1974 San Francisco. Told from the character’s perspective, Julie’s new journal format is a historical collection first, featuring full-color doodles and non-fiction back matter with details related to the story and era. The new illustrated journal will now come with the 18-inch Julie™ doll and is also available wherever books are sold. Additional illustrated journals and diaries for other historical characters are slated to debut in 2025 and beyond.', 'To further expand its storytelling, American Girl is also partnering with IDW Publishing to introduce a first-ever graphic-novel mystery series based on the popular historical characters. The first mystery—Julie and the Blue Guitar—is debuting this June, with a second book based on the late-’90s duo, Isabel and Nicki, releasing in spring 2025. More graphic mystery novels are planned to follow and will be available wherever books are sold. To support parents and educators, American Girl is also updating its free, downloadable discussion and teaching guides based on the historical character series in June 2024 at americangirl.com.', 'Fans can celebrate their favorite American Girl historical characters in person or online by:', 'visiting American Girl retail stores to enjoy a special Historical Character Birthday Teatime or Julie’s Groovy Painting Party at the signature cafes; book an appointment for a classic ’do at the Dolled Up Salon; explore new product and story collections, and more.', 'checking out American Girl’s TikTok channel and Instagram for fun historical character-themed TikTok trends, in-feed posts and stories, promotions, and book content.', 'watching new Julie-inspired videos starting in late May on American Girl’s popular YouTube and YouTube Kids Channel.', 'touring Addy, Josefina, Kirsten, and Julie’s rooms and exploring all the AG characters at the free Virtual Museum, and', 'learning more character background details on American Girl Wiki.', 'American Girl’s new tribute collections for Kirsten, Addy, and Josefina, plus the new Julie products and stories, are available now at americangirl.com and American Girl retail stores nationwide.', 'ABOUT AMERICAN GIRL', 'American Girl is a premium brand for girls and a wholly-owned subsidiary of Mattel, Inc. (NASDAQ: MAT, www.mattel.com), a leading global toy company and owner of one of the strongest portfolios of children’s and family entertainment franchises in the world. American Girl offers an inspiring world of dolls, content, and experiences that nourish a girl’s spirit and help develop her strength of character. Best-selling lines include Truly Me™, Girl of the Year™, Bitty Baby®, WellieWishers™, Create Your Own™, and American Girl’s classic historical characters. The company sells products through its award-winning catalogue, on americangirl.com, in its proprietary U.S. experiential retail stores, as well as at specialty retailers nationwide. By inspiring girls to be their best, American Girl has earned the loyalty of millions and the praise and trust of parents and educators. Connect with American Girl on: YouTube; Facebook; Instagram; TikTok; Pinterest', 'MAT-AG', 'View source version on businesswire.com: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20240513975758/en/', 'Contacts', 'Laura Mays, Weber Shandwick, lmays@webershandwick.com Julie Parks, American Girl: julie.parks@americangirl.com']

Title: Mattel Appoints Karen Ancira Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer
Text: ['EL SEGUNDO, Calif., May 08, 2024--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Mattel, Inc. (NASDAQ: MAT) announced today that Karen Ancira has been appointed Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer for the company, effective May 15, 2024. Ms. Ancira will report to Ynon Kreiz, Chairman and CEO of Mattel.', 'Mr. Kreiz said: "Karen is an exceptional leader with a proven track record of cultivating purpose-driven, values-based Human Resources organizations and programs for major consumer brands globally. We look forward to the impact Karen will make to further inspire and engage our high-performing and collaborative workforce at Mattel."', 'Joining Mattel following 11 years with Yum! Brands, Ms. Ancira was most recently Chief People and Culture Officer, KFC, US and previously for KFC in Australia, Latin America, and the Caribbean. She also held senior Human Resources roles for the brand in UK and Ireland. From 2005-2012, Ms. Ancira served in HR leadership positions at PepsiCo in Monterrey, Mexico, creating and overseeing HR programs across Mexico, Latin America, and the Caribbean.', "Ms. Ancira brings to Mattel strong expertise in building progressive workplace cultures, fostering organizational development and effectiveness, and spearheading DE&I initiatives. During her tenure at Yum! Brands, Ancira developed a global leadership and character-building program that was implemented across the entire Yum! Brands portfolio. She also led the end-to-end HR agenda for the employee base, led the US organization through a leadership transformation, achieved 100% parity in gender pay for the US, and was instrumental in crafting and launching the business's transformation strategy.", 'Ms. Ancira added: "Mattel’s iconic portfolio is matched only by its passionate and committed global workforce. I have long admired the values of the company and identify deeply with the purpose behind its brands, and its relevance and importance to society. It is an honor to join this world-class leadership team to lead and enhance Mattel’s thriving culture and develop new People and Culture programs to help everyone succeed in this next exciting chapter for the company."', 'Ms. Ancira holds a BA in Economics from the University of Monterrey in Mexico and received an MBA from EAE Business School in Madrid, Spain. She is a member of the Board of Directors of the Latino Leadership Institute. Ms. Ancira will be based at Mattel’s global headquarters in El Segundo, California.', 'About Mattel', 'Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. Title: Three American Girl Classics Are Back! Kirsten™, Addy™, and Josefina™ Return to Flagship Historical Line With Original Tribute Collections
Text: ['The brand’s grooviest girl — 1970s-era character Julie Albright™— also shines bright with all-new product collection and stories', 'MIDDLETON, Wis., May 13, 2024--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Today, American Girl, a cornerstone in the Mattel (NASDAQ: MAT) portfolio of purposeful brands, announced the re-release of three classic historical characters — Kirsten Larson™, Addy Walker™, and Josefina Montoya™— with special tribute collections that harken back to the brand’s roots. Kirsten, Addy, and Josefina (originally debuting in 1986, 1993, and 1997 respectively) remain fan-favorite characters that have inspired generations with their timeless stories that celebrate family and friendship, resilience in the face of change, and hope for the future. Now, these enduring characters are set to stir up a wave of nostalgia and inspire a legion of new fans with the debut of these three keepsake collections, featuring their original fashions and accessories, along with updated stories to bring the characters’ worlds to life in a fresh, relevant way.', '"As we look back on American Girl’s rich legacy, it’s our beloved historical characters and their powerful stories that have transcended the test of time—instilling in generations of girls and women an understanding of their own important place in the world," says Jamie Cygielman, General Manager of American Girl. "Through the return of such classics as Kirsten, Addy, and Josefina, along with new product and story offerings for our other timeless characters, like 1970s Julie Albright, we’re excited to continue engaging and inspiring American Girl fans of all ages for years to come."', 'The new throwback collections feature a signature 18-inch Kirsten, Addy, and Josefina doll that comes dressed in the character’s original debut outfit, along with her authentic introductory accessories. Arriving in a retro American Girls Collection™ box, each set also includes the character’s first paperback book in the series with vintage cover design and updated language, imagery, and resources to resonate with today’s readers. And, to celebrate birthdays through the decades, American Girl is also reissuing Kirsten, Addy, and Josefina’s original birthday party dresses and accompanying Happy Birthday books with original cover designs.', 'Additionally, for fans of American Girl’s beloved 1970s historical character, Julie Albright, there’s a new assortment of flower-power fun, including a totally retro school outfit and floral metal lunch box; a funky floral jumpsuit; a record player set with doll-sized records that play ’70s-inspired songs; and a fun skating outfit with lace-on shoe roller skates that really roll. In addition, American Girl Publishing released a new illustrated journal to tell Julie’s story of growing up in 1974 San Francisco. Told from the character’s perspective, Julie’s new journal format is a historical collection first, featuring full-color doodles and non-fiction back matter with details related to the story and era. The new illustrated journal will now come with the 18-inch Julie™ doll and is also available wherever books are sold. Additional illustrated journals and diaries for other historical characters are slated to debut in 2025 and beyond.', 'To further expand its storytelling, American Girl is also partnering with IDW Publishing to introduce a first-ever graphic-novel mystery series based on the popular historical characters. The first mystery—Julie and the Blue Guitar—is debuting this June, with a second book based on the late-’90s duo, Isabel and Nicki, releasing in spring 2025. More graphic mystery novels are planned to follow and will be available wherever books are sold. To support parents and educators, American Girl is also updating its free, downloadable discussion and teaching guides based on the historical character series in June 2024 at americangirl.com.', 'Fans can celebrate their favorite American Girl historical characters in person or online by:', 'visiting American Girl retail stores to enjoy a special Historical Character Birthday Teatime or Julie’s Groovy Painting Party at the signature cafes; book an appointment for a classic ’do at the Dolled Up Salon; explore new product and story collections, and more.', 'checking out American Girl’s TikTok channel and Instagram for fun historical character-themed TikTok trends, in-feed posts and stories, promotions, and book content.', 'watching new Julie-inspired videos starting in late May on American Girl’s popular YouTube and YouTube Kids Channel.', 'touring Addy, Josefina, Kirsten, and Julie’s rooms and exploring all the AG characters at the free Virtual Museum, and', 'learning more character background details on American Girl Wiki.', 'American Girl’s new tribute collections for Kirsten, Addy, and Josefina, plus the new Julie products and stories, are available now at americangirl.com and American Girl retail stores nationwide.', 'ABOUT AMERICAN GIRL', 'American Girl is a premium brand for girls and a wholly-owned subsidiary of Mattel, Inc. (NASDAQ: MAT, www.mattel.com), a leading global toy company and owner of one of the strongest portfolios of children’s and family entertainment franchises in the world. American Girl offers an inspiring world of dolls, content, and experiences that nourish a girl’s spirit and help develop her strength of character. Best-selling lines include Truly Me™, Girl of the Year™, Bitty Baby®, WellieWishers™, Create Your Own™, and American Girl’s classic historical characters. The company sells products through its award-winning catalogue, on americangirl.com, in its proprietary U.S. experiential retail stores, as well as at specialty retailers nationwide. By inspiring girls to be their best, American Girl has earned the loyalty of millions and the praise and trust of parents and educators. Connect with American Girl on: YouTube; Facebook; Instagram; TikTok; Pinterest', 'MAT-AG', 'View source version on businesswire.com: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20240513975758/en/', 'Contacts', 'Laura Mays, Weber Shandwick, lmays@webershandwick.com Julie Parks, American Girl: julie.parks@americangirl.com']

Title: Mattel Appoints Karen Ancira Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer
Text: ['EL SEGUNDO, Calif., May 08, 2024--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Mattel, Inc. (NASDAQ: MAT) announced today that Karen Ancira has been appointed Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer for the company, effective May 15, 2024. Ms. Ancira will report to Ynon Kreiz, Chairman and CEO of Mattel.', 'Mr. Kreiz said: "Karen is an exceptional leader with a proven track record of cultivating purpose-driven, values-based Human Resources organizations and programs for major consumer brands globally. We look forward to the impact Karen will make to further inspire and engage our high-performing and collaborative workforce at Mattel."', 'Joining Mattel following 11 years with Yum! Brands, Ms. Ancira was most recently Chief People and Culture Officer, KFC, US and previously for KFC in Australia, Latin America, and the Caribbean. She also held senior Human Resources roles for the brand in UK and Ireland. From 2005-2012, Ms. Ancira served in HR leadership positions at PepsiCo in Monterrey, Mexico, creating and overseeing HR programs across Mexico, Latin America, and the Caribbean.', "Ms. Ancira brings to Mattel strong expertise in building progressive workplace cultures, fostering organizational development and effectiveness, and spearheading DE&I initiatives. During her tenure at Yum! Brands, Ancira developed a global leadership and character-building program that was implemented across the entire Yum! Brands portfolio. She also led the end-to-end HR agenda for the employee base, led the US organization through a leadership transformation, achieved 100% parity in gender pay for the US, and was instrumental in crafting and launching the business's transformation strategy.", 'Ms. Ancira added: "Mattel’s iconic portfolio is matched only by its passionate and committed global workforce. I have long admired the values of the company and identify deeply with the purpose behind its brands, and its relevance and importance to society. It is an honor to join this world-class leadership team to lead and enhance Mattel’s thriving culture and develop new People and Culture programs to help everyone succeed in this next exciting chapter for the company."', 'Ms. Ancira holds a BA in Economics from the University of Monterrey in Mexico and received an MBA from EAE Business School in Madrid, Spain. She is a member of the Board of Directors of the Latino Leadership Institute. Ms. Ancira will be based at Mattel’s global headquarters in El Segundo, California.', 'About Mattel', 'Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. Title: Fisher-Price® Introduces New Premium Wooden Toys to Inspire Creativity and Promote Development in Young Children
Text: ['Available Exclusively at Walmart, Fisher-Price Wood Prioritizes Modern Designs and On-Trend Themes at Affordable Prices for Families', 'EAST AURORA, N.Y., May 16, 2024--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Fisher-Price® (NASDAQ: MAT), a pioneer in creating quality, educational toys for young kids, today unveiled its all-new wooden toy line, Fisher-Price Wood, for children ages 6 months to 5 years. Featuring fresh, modern designs that encourage open-ended play, the new wooden toy line speaks to parents who are looking for a more affordable, back-to-basics play experience for their children. In addition, the products are made with wood from FSC®-certified sources and designed to last, allowing families to pass them down from generation to generation. With early childhood development at the forefront of Fisher-Price’s purpose, these wooden toys offer a wide range of fun play patterns—from colorful puzzles and blocks to role play, music-making and more—that help spark creativity, develop fine motor skills, and stimulate problem-solving. Fisher-Price Wood is now available exclusively at select Walmart stores and on Walmart.com.', 'Brian Fitzharris, SVP and General Manager, Fisher-Price, said: "For 94 years, Fisher-Price has been dedicated to helping children have the best possible start in life through innovative, trusted toys that provide hours of fun and enrichment. With the debut of Fisher-Price Wood—a line that harkens back to the brand’s very roots—we’re bringing a fresh perspective to the timeless appeal of wooden toys that are affordably priced, made from FSC®-certified wood, and designed to nourish a child’s creativity and development."', 'Brittany Smith, Vice President of Toys, Walmart, added: "We are excited to be the exclusive retailer for the newest innovation from Fisher-Price—the Fisher-Price Wood assortment of preschool toys. This new assortment is on-trend with what parents are looking for and we’re excited to be able to offer them quality toys at an affordable price."', 'Tested in the Fisher-Price™ Play Lab, the new wooden toys incorporate playful, colorful elements that are more than just fun—they also help childhood development by stimulating the brain through open-ended play, helping kids explore the world at their own pace. Fisher-Price Wood offers an array of products at accessible price points, including the following:', 'Fisher-Price ® Wooden Ring Stacker, (SRP: $14.82 | 18M+): Toddlers will love sorting, stacking, and spinning the easy-to-grasp colorful scalloped shaped rings on the wooden stacking base, developing their fine motor skills as they play.', 'Fisher-Price ® Wooden Activity Triangle, (SRP: $19.74 | 6M+): Little ones can explore the double-sided animal panel, sliding knobs, spinning gears and 3 shapes that twist along the triangle’s corkscrew rod to exercise their fine motor and problem-solving play on its own, encouraging creativity while helping develop fine motor skills.', 'Fisher-Price ® Wooden Mandala Puzzle, (SRP: $19.74 | 3Y+): This beautiful puzzle includes 40 shape pieces and a tray with guidelines to help kids sort the shapes into the correct slots to complete the geometric Mandala design, exercising hand-eye coordination and attention skills.', 'Fisher-Price ® Wooden Coffee To Go Set, (SRP: $19.74 | 3Y+): Preschool kids can brew up hours of pretend play with this 15-piece set, which includes 3 takeout beverage cups & sleeves, a spoon to stir, 2 cookies and 2 marshmallows for "snacking," and cup holder to carry it all.', 'Fisher-Price ® Wooden Toolbox Set, (SRP: $19.74 | 3Y+): This 9-piece playset has everything your little DIY-er needs, including a toy drill, hammer, screwdriver, wrench, saw, pliers, square ruler, bottle of glue, and a toolbox to build all kinds of pretend projects.', 'Fisher-Price ® Wooden Treehouse Ball Run, (SRP: $24.82 | 9M+): Kids can use the lever to pop the ball to ring the treehouse bell, or they can drop the ball on the ramp, so it rolls down to start the fun all over again, helping discover cause & effect while developing fine motor skills.', 'Fisher-Price ® Wooden Stacking Blocks, (SRP: $24.82 | 18M+): From stacking and matching to making patterns and building structures, inspire your toddler’s creativity through skill-building activities with these classic Wooden Stacking Blocks. Available in June.', 'Fisher-Price ® Stacking Shape Sorter, (SRP: $24.82 | 18M+): This set features easy-to-grasp wooden rings, octagons and 2-part geometric rectangles to sort and stack on the base, introducing your child to sizes, colors, shapes and more!', 'Fisher-Price ® Wooden Music Table, (SRP: $24.82 | 2Y+): Kids can find their rhythm and exercise their fine motor skills using the mallets to play the xylophone, cymbal, and guiro.', 'Fisher-Price Wood is available now at select Walmart stores and on Walmart.com.
