Text: ['The brand’s grooviest girl — 1970s-era character Julie Albright™— also shines bright with all-new product collection and stories', 'MIDDLETON, Wis., May 13, 2024--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Today, American Girl, a cornerstone in the Mattel (NASDAQ: MAT) portfolio of purposeful brands, announced the re-release of three classic historical characters — Kirsten Larson™, Addy Walker™, and Josefina Montoya™— with special tribute collections that harken back to the brand’s roots. Kirsten, Addy, and Josefina (originally debuting in 1986, 1993, and 1997 respectively) remain fan-favorite characters that have inspired generations with their timeless stories that celebrate family and friendship, resilience in the face of change, and hope for the future. Now, these enduring characters are set to stir up a wave of nostalgia and inspire a legion of new fans with the debut of these three keepsake collections, featuring their original fashions and accessories, along with updated stories to bring the characters’ worlds to life in a fresh, relevant way.', '"As we look back on American Girl’s rich legacy, it’s our beloved historical characters and their powerful stories that have transcended the test of time—instilling in generations of girls and women an understanding of their own important place in the world," says Jamie Cygielman, General Manager of American Girl. "Through the return of such classics as Kirsten, Addy, and Josefina, along with new product and story offerings for our other timeless characters, like 1970s Julie Albright, we’re excited to continue engaging and inspiring American Girl fans of all ages for years to come."', 'The new throwback collections feature a signature 18-inch Kirsten, Addy, and Josefina doll that comes dressed in the character’s original debut outfit, along with her authentic introductory accessories. Arriving in a retro American Girls Collection™ box, each set also includes the character’s first paperback book in the series with vintage cover design and updated language, imagery, and resources to resonate with today’s readers. And, to celebrate birthdays through the decades, American Girl is also reissuing Kirsten, Addy, and Josefina’s original birthday party dresses and accompanying Happy Birthday books with original cover designs.', 'Additionally, for fans of American Girl’s beloved 1970s historical character, Julie Albright, there’s a new assortment of flower-power fun, including a totally retro school outfit and floral metal lunch box; a funky floral jumpsuit; a record player set with doll-sized records that play ’70s-inspired songs; and a fun skating outfit with lace-on shoe roller skates that really roll. In addition, American Girl Publishing released a new illustrated journal to tell Julie’s story of growing up in 1974 San Francisco. Told from the character’s perspective, Julie’s new journal format is a historical collection first, featuring full-color doodles and non-fiction back matter with details related to the story and era. The new illustrated journal will now come with the 18-inch Julie™ doll and is also available wherever books are sold. Additional illustrated journals and diaries for other historical characters are slated to debut in 2025 and beyond.', 'To further expand its storytelling, American Girl is also partnering with IDW Publishing to introduce a first-ever graphic-novel mystery series based on the popular historical characters. The first mystery—Julie and the Blue Guitar—is debuting this June, with a second book based on the late-’90s duo, Isabel and Nicki, releasing in spring 2025. More graphic mystery novels are planned to follow and will be available wherever books are sold. To support parents and educators, American Girl is also updating its free, downloadable discussion and teaching guides based on the historical character series in June 2024 at americangirl.com.', 'Fans can celebrate their favorite American Girl historical characters in person or online by:', 'visiting American Girl retail stores to enjoy a special Historical Character Birthday Teatime or Julie’s Groovy Painting Party at the signature cafes; book an appointment for a classic ’do at the Dolled Up Salon; explore new product and story collections, and more.', 'checking out American Girl’s TikTok channel and Instagram for fun historical character-themed TikTok trends, in-feed posts and stories, promotions, and book content.', 'watching new Julie-inspired videos starting in late May on American Girl’s popular YouTube and YouTube Kids Channel.', 'touring Addy, Josefina, Kirsten, and Julie’s rooms and exploring all the AG characters at the free Virtual Museum, and', 'learning more character background details on American Girl Wiki.', 'American Girl’s new tribute collections for Kirsten, Addy, and Josefina, plus the new Julie products and stories, are available now at americangirl.com and American Girl retail stores nationwide.', 'ABOUT AMERICAN GIRL', 'American Girl is a premium brand for girls and a wholly-owned subsidiary of Mattel, Inc. (NASDAQ: MAT, www.mattel.com), a leading global toy company and owner of one of the strongest portfolios of children’s and family entertainment franchises in the world. American Girl offers an inspiring world of dolls, content, and experiences that nourish a girl’s spirit and help develop her strength of character. Best-selling lines include Truly Me™, Girl of the Year™, Bitty Baby®, WellieWishers™, Create Your Own™, and American Girl’s classic historical characters. The company sells products through its award-winning catalogue, on americangirl.com, in its proprietary U.S. experiential retail stores, as well as at specialty retailers nationwide. By inspiring girls to be their best, American Girl has earned the loyalty of millions and the praise and trust of parents and educators. Connect with American Girl on: YouTube; Facebook; Instagram; TikTok; Pinterest', 'MAT-AG', 'View source version on businesswire.com: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20240513975758/en/', 'Contacts', 'Laura Mays, Weber Shandwick, lmays@webershandwick.com Julie Parks, American Girl: julie.parks@americangirl.com']

Text: ['For new investors looking for their first stock with limited cash, the low-priced stocks make sense as a starting ground. Title: Mattel Appoints Karen Ancira Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer
Text: ['EL SEGUNDO, Calif., May 08, 2024--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Mattel, Inc. (NASDAQ: MAT) announced today that Karen Ancira has been appointed Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer for the company, effective May 15, 2024. Ms. Ancira will report to Ynon Kreiz, Chairman and CEO of Mattel.', 'Mr. Kreiz said: "Karen is an exceptional leader with a proven track record of cultivating purpose-driven, values-based Human Resources organizations and programs for major consumer brands globally. Title: The 3 Best Under $20 Stocks to Buy in May 2024
Text: ['For new investors looking for their first stock with limited cash, the low-priced stocks make sense as a starting ground. Though low prices, such as $20 per share, are more within reach of smaller retail investors, they are not exactly indicative of deep undervaluation.', 'To value a stock appropriately, investors should check valuation ratios, such as the trailing and forward price-to-earnings (P/E) ratios. Then, compare those against comparable plays or the industry average.', 'Of course, other ratios deserve some attention as you evaluate a firm. Of the following three stocks, two appear to be deeply undervalued. Let’s explore this trio, which may be an excellent choices for contrarians this May.', 'InvestorPlace - Stock Market News, Stock Advice & Trading Tips', 'Source: Ingus Kruklitis / Shutterstock.com', 'Warner Bros. Discovery (NASDAQ:WBD) has been quite a disastrous merger for investors who jumped into the stock at almost any point over the past year. At $7.80 per share, WBD stock certainly looks like a play that’s deep with value. Yet, the fundamentals seem to be fading, not just with Warner Bros. Discovery but the media industry as a whole.', 'Indeed, the bottom in the stock may still be a ways off for contrarians hoping for quick gain. The $19 billion company still has loads of debt, and the advertising headwinds have continued to weigh.', 'At this juncture, a merger with another distressed media firm seems like wishful thinking. Until now, the company has struggled to find a balance between growth and trimming costs. To keep up with the streaming heavyweights, one needs to spend a great deal. However, that will cut further into profits and limit debt repayments.', 'So, no easy answers are apparent for Warner Bros. Discovery. However, the stock looks incredibly cheap at 0.46 times price-to-book (P/B). At these depths, expectations may just be low enough to be worth the risk.', 'Source: NAN728 / Shutterstock.com', 'Known for its branded “Fun Ship” cruise line, Carnival (NYSE:CCL) stock has been cruising sideways since bouncing back modestly from its 2020 lows. Truly, demand for cruise lines has been picking up lately. But CCL stock has dragged its feet relative to its better-performing rivals. As the industry heals from the heavy hit of the pandemic, Carnival will eventually have the means to gain traction again.', 'Until then, Carnival has stood out as more of a budget option in a market that seems to favor high-end luxury players. CCL seems to be better suited for families and consumers with average incomes. Unfortunately, these folks have had inflation hit them quite hard.', 'On the plus side, Carnival’s latest quarter saw smaller losses than expected. However, it doesn’t look like CCL stock is going to hang onto the gains, with shares dipping more than 3% on Tuesday. In any case, CCL stock stands out as a relative bargain at 13.3 times forward P/E. At just over $14 per share, Carnival stands out as a great long-term bet for those bullish on a continued recovery in travel and leisure.', 'Source: Ken Wolter / Shutterstock', 'Mattel (NASDAQ:MAT) is the legendary toy company behind Barbie and Fisher-Price. Lately, the stock has been fluctuating wildly, with the stock down 26% over the past two years and around 60% from its 2013 all-time highs. Undoubtedly, MAT stock has been quite a long-time laggard.', 'And, while the Barbie movie jolt may be starting to fade, I do think the stock remains an attractive value option for patient investors. At $18.72 per share, Mattel is certainly an ideal first buy for a new investor looking for consumer brands.', 'About two weeks ago, Mattel reported a soft quarter in which revenue fell 1% year-over-year (YOY). Despite an unimpressive showing, the toy company saw notable strength in the North American market. Furthermore, the big three brands of Barbie, Hot Wheels and Fisher-Price posted decent numbers.', 'Moving ahead, earnings could begin to march higher as discretionary budgets improve. The stock goes for 13.2 times forward P/E, which may be far too cheap for so many legendary toy brands.', 'On the date of publication, Joey Frenette did not hold (either directly or indirectly) any positions in the securities mentioned in this article. The opinions expressed in this article are those of the writer, subject to the InvestorPlace.com\xa0Publishing Guidelines.', 'Joey Frenette is a seasoned investment writer specializing in technology and consumer stocks. Contributing to the Motley Fool Canada, TipRanks, and Barchart, Joey excels in spotting mispriced stocks with long-term growth potential in a fast-paced market.', 'The #1 AI Investment Might Be This Company You’ve Never Heard Of', 'Musk’s “Project Omega” May Be Set to Mint New Millionaires. Title: Mattel Appoints Karen Ancira Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer
Text: ['EL SEGUNDO, Calif., May 08, 2024--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Mattel, Inc. (NASDAQ: MAT) announced today that Karen Ancira has been appointed Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer for the company, effective May 15, 2024. Ms. Ancira will report to Ynon Kreiz, Chairman and CEO of Mattel.', 'Mr. Kreiz said: "Karen is an exceptional leader with a proven track record of cultivating purpose-driven, values-based Human Resources organizations and programs for major consumer brands globally. We look forward to the impact Karen will make to further inspire and engage our high-performing and collaborative workforce at Mattel."', 'Joining Mattel following 11 years with Yum! Brands, Ms. Ancira was most recently Chief People and Culture Officer, KFC, US and previously for KFC in Australia, Latin America, and the Caribbean. She also held senior Human Resources roles for the brand in UK and Ireland. From 2005-2012, Ms. Ancira served in HR leadership positions at PepsiCo in Monterrey, Mexico, creating and overseeing HR programs across Mexico, Latin America, and the Caribbean.', "Ms. Ancira brings to Mattel strong expertise in building progressive workplace cultures, fostering organizational development and effectiveness, and spearheading DE&I initiatives. During her tenure at Yum! Brands, Ancira developed a global leadership and character-building program that was implemented across the entire Yum! Brands portfolio. She also led the end-to-end HR agenda for the employee base, led the US organization through a leadership transformation, achieved 100% parity in gender pay for the US, and was instrumental in crafting and launching the business's transformation strategy.", 'Ms. Ancira added: "Mattel’s iconic portfolio is matched only by its passionate and committed global workforce. I have long admired the values of the company and identify deeply with the purpose behind its brands, and its relevance and importance to society. It is an honor to join this world-class leadership team to lead and enhance Mattel’s thriving culture and develop new People and Culture programs to help everyone succeed in this next exciting chapter for the company."', 'Ms. Ancira holds a BA in Economics from the University of Monterrey in Mexico and received an MBA from EAE Business School in Madrid, Spain. She is a member of the Board of Directors of the Latino Leadership Institute. Ms. Ancira will be based at Mattel’s global headquarters in El Segundo, California.', 'About Mattel', 'Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. Title: Fisher-Price® Introduces New Premium Wooden Toys to Inspire Creativity and Promote Development in Young Children
Text: ['Available Exclusively at Walmart, Fisher-Price Wood Prioritizes Modern Designs and On-Trend Themes at Affordable Prices for Families', 'EAST AURORA, N.Y., May 16, 2024--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Fisher-Price® (NASDAQ: MAT), a pioneer in creating quality, educational toys for young kids, today unveiled its all-new wooden toy line, Fisher-Price Wood, for children ages 6 months to 5 years. Featuring fresh, modern designs that encourage open-ended play, the new wooden toy line speaks to parents who are looking for a more affordable, back-to-basics play experience for their children. In addition, the products are made with wood from FSC®-certified sources and designed to last, allowing families to pass them down from generation to generation. With early childhood development at the forefront of Fisher-Price’s purpose, these wooden toys offer a wide range of fun play patterns—from colorful puzzles and blocks to role play, music-making and more—that help spark creativity, develop fine motor skills, and stimulate problem-solving. Fisher-Price Wood is now available exclusively at select Walmart stores and on Walmart.com.', 'Brian Fitzharris, SVP and General Manager, Fisher-Price, said: "For 94 years, Fisher-Price has been dedicated to helping children have the best possible start in life through innovative, trusted toys that provide hours of fun and enrichment. With the debut of Fisher-Price Wood—a line that harkens back to the brand’s very roots—we’re bringing a fresh perspective to the timeless appeal of wooden toys that are affordably priced, made from FSC®-certified wood, and designed to nourish a child’s creativity and development."', 'Brittany Smith, Vice President of Toys, Walmart, added: "We are excited to be the exclusive retailer for the newest innovation from Fisher-Price—the Fisher-Price Wood assortment of preschool toys. 6M+): Little ones can explore the double-sided animal panel, sliding knobs, spinning gears and 3 shapes that twist along the triangle’s corkscrew rod to exercise their fine motor and problem-solving activities with these classic Wooden Stacking Blocks. Available in June.', 'Fisher-Price ® Stacking Shape Sorter, (SRP: $24.82 | 18M+): This set features easy-to-grasp wooden rings, octagons and 2-part geometric rectangles to sort and stack on the base, introducing your child to sizes, colors, shapes and more!', 'Fisher-Price ® Wooden Music Table, (SRP: $24.82 | 2Y+): Kids can find their rhythm and exercise their fine motor skills using the mallets to play the xylophone, cymbal, and guiro.', 'Fisher-Price Wood is available now at select Walmart stores and on Walmart.com. Title: The 3 Best Under $20 Stocks to Buy in May 2024
Text: ['For new investors looking for their first stock with limited cash, the low-priced stocks make sense as a starting ground. Though low prices, such as $20 per share, are more within reach of smaller retail investors, they are not exactly indicative of deep undervaluation.', 'To value a stock appropriately, investors should check valuation ratios, such as the trailing and forward price-to-earnings (P/E) ratios. Then, compare those against comparable plays or the industry average.', 'Of course, other ratios deserve some attention as you evaluate a firm. Discovery (NASDAQ:WBD) has been quite a disastrous merger for investors who jumped into the stock at almost any point over the past year. At $7.80 per share, WBD stock certainly looks like a play that’s deep with value. Yet, the fundamentals seem to be fading, not just with Warner Bros. Discovery but the media industry as a whole.', 'Indeed, the bottom in the stock may still be a ways off for contrarians hoping for quick gain. The $19 billion company still has loads of debt, and the advertising headwinds have continued to weigh.', 'At this juncture, a merger with another distressed media firm seems like wishful thinking. Until now, the company has struggled to find a balance between growth and trimming costs. To keep up with the streaming heavyweights, one needs to spend a great deal. However, that will cut further into profits and limit debt repayments.', 'So, no easy answers are apparent for Warner Bros. Discovery. At these depths, expectations may just be low enough to be worth the risk.', 'Source: NAN728 / Shutterstock.com', 'Known for its branded “Fun Ship” cruise line, Carnival (NYSE:CCL) stock has been cruising sideways since bouncing back modestly from its 2020 lows. As the industry heals from the heavy hit of the pandemic, Carnival will eventually have the means to gain traction again.', 'Until then, Carnival has stood out as more of a budget option in a market that seems to favor high-end luxury players. Unfortunately, these folks have had inflation hit them quite hard.', 'On the plus side, Carnival’s latest quarter saw smaller losses than expected. Title: Mattel Appoints Karen Ancira Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer
Text: ['EL SEGUNDO, Calif., May 08, 2024--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Mattel, Inc. (NASDAQ: MAT) announced today that Karen Ancira has been appointed Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer for the company, effective May 15, 2024. Ms. Ancira will report to Ynon Kreiz, Chairman and CEO of Mattel.', 'Mr. Kreiz said: "Karen is an exceptional leader with a proven track record of cultivating purpose-driven, values-based Human Resources organizations and programs for major consumer brands globally. We look forward to the impact Karen will make to further inspire and engage our high-performing and collaborative workforce at Mattel."', 'Joining Mattel following 11 years with Yum! Brands, Ms. Ancira was most recently Chief People and Culture Officer, KFC, US and previously for KFC in Australia, Latin America, and the Caribbean. She also held senior Human Resources roles for the brand in UK and Ireland. From 2005-2012, Ms. Ancira served in HR leadership positions at PepsiCo in Monterrey, Mexico, creating and overseeing HR programs across Mexico, Latin America, and the Caribbean.', "Ms. Ancira brings to Mattel strong expertise in building progressive workplace cultures, fostering organizational development and effectiveness, and spearheading DE&I initiatives. During her tenure at Yum! Brands, Ancira developed a global leadership and character-building program that was implemented across the entire Yum! Brands portfolio. She also led the end-to-end HR agenda for the employee base, led the US organization through a leadership transformation, achieved 100% parity in gender pay for the US, and was instrumental in crafting and launching the business's transformation strategy.", 'Ms. Ancira added: "Mattel’s iconic portfolio is matched only by its passionate and committed global workforce. I have long admired the values of the company and identify deeply with the purpose behind its brands, and its relevance and importance to society. It is an honor to join this world-class leadership team to lead and enhance Mattel’s thriving culture and develop new People and Culture programs to help everyone succeed in this next exciting chapter for the company."', 'Ms. Ancira holds a BA in Economics from the University of Monterrey in Mexico and received an MBA from EAE Business School in Madrid, Spain. She is a member of the Board of Directors of the Latino Leadership Institute. Title: Fisher-Price® Introduces New Premium Wooden Toys to Inspire Creativity and Promote Development in Young Children
Text: ['Available Exclusively at Walmart, Fisher-Price Wood Prioritizes Modern Designs and On-Trend Themes at Affordable Prices for Families', 'EAST AURORA, N.Y., May 16, 2024--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Fisher-Price® (NASDAQ: MAT), a pioneer in creating quality, educational toys for young kids, today unveiled its all-new wooden toy line, Fisher-Price Wood, for children ages 6 months to 5 years. Featuring fresh, modern designs that encourage open-ended play, the new wooden toy line speaks to parents who are looking for a more affordable, back-to-basics play experience for their children. In addition, the products are made with wood from FSC®-certified sources and designed to last, allowing families to pass them down from generation to generation. With early childhood development at the forefront of Fisher-Price’s purpose, these wooden toys offer a wide range of fun play patterns—from colorful puzzles and blocks to role play, music-making and more—that help spark creativity, develop fine motor skills, and stimulate problem-solving. Fisher-Price Wood is now available exclusively at select Walmart stores and on Walmart.com.', 'Brian Fitzharris, SVP and General Manager, Fisher-Price, said: "For 94 years, Fisher-Price has been dedicated to helping children have the best possible start in life through innovative, trusted toys that provide hours of fun and enrichment. With the debut of Fisher-Price Wood—a line that harkens back to the brand’s very roots—we’re bringing a fresh perspective to the timeless appeal of wooden toys that are affordably priced, made from FSC®-certified wood, and designed to nourish a child’s creativity and development."', 'Brittany Smith, Vice President of Toys, Walmart, added: "We are excited to be the exclusive retailer for the newest innovation from Fisher-Price—the Fisher-Price Wood assortment of preschool toys. This new assortment is on-trend with what parents are looking for and we’re excited to be able to offer them quality toys at an affordable price."', 'Tested in the Fisher-Price™ Play Lab, the new wooden toys incorporate playful, colorful elements that are more than just fun—they also help childhood development by stimulating the brain through open-ended play, helping kids explore the world at their own pace. Fisher-Price Wood offers an array of products at accessible price points, including the following:', 'Fisher-Price ® Wooden Ring Stacker, (SRP: $14.82 | 18M+): Toddlers will love sorting, stacking, and spinning the easy-to-grasp colorful scalloped shaped rings on the wooden stacking base, developing their fine motor skills as they play.', 'Fisher-Price ® Wooden Activity Triangle, (SRP: $19.74 | 6M+): Little ones can explore the double-sided animal panel, sliding knobs, spinning gears and 3 shapes that twist along the triangle’s corkscrew rod to exercise their fine motor and problem-solving skills.', 'Fisher-Price ® Pound and Tap Bench Xylophone, (SRP: $24.82 | 18M+): Two toys in 1, kids can pound or push the balls through the holes to strike the xylophone keys or remove the xylophone to play on its own, encouraging creativity while helping develop fine motor skills.', 'Fisher-Price ® Wooden Mandala Puzzle, (SRP: $19.74 | 3Y+): This beautiful puzzle includes 40 shape pieces and a tray with guidelines to help kids sort the shapes into the correct slots to complete the geometric Mandala design, exercising hand-eye coordination and attention skills.', 'Fisher-Price ® Wooden Coffee To Go Set, (SRP: $19.74 | 3Y+): Preschool kids can brew up hours of pretend play with this 15-piece set, which includes 3 takeout beverage cups & sleeves, a spoon to stir, 2 cookies and 2 marshmallows for "snacking," and cup holder to carry it all.', 'Fisher-Price ® Wooden Toolbox Set, (SRP: $19.74 | 3Y+): This 9-piece playset has everything your little DIY-er needs, including a toy drill, hammer, screwdriver, wrench, saw, pliers, square ruler, bottle of glue, and a toolbox to build all kinds of pretend projects.', 'Fisher-Price ® Wooden Treehouse Ball Run, (SRP: $24.82 | 9M+): Kids can use the lever to pop the ball to ring the treehouse bell, or they can drop the ball on the ramp, so it rolls down to start the fun all over again, helping discover cause & effect while developing fine motor skills.', 'Fisher-Price ® Wooden Stacking Blocks, (SRP: $24.82 | 18M+): From stacking and matching to making patterns and building structures, inspire your toddler’s creativity through skill-building activities with these classic Wooden Stacking Blocks. Available in June.', 'Fisher-Price ® Stacking Shape Sorter, (SRP: $24.82 | 18M+): This set features easy-to-grasp wooden rings, octagons and 2-part geometric rectangles to sort and stack on the base, introducing your child to sizes, colors, shapes and more!', 'Fisher-Price ® Wooden Music Table, (SRP: $24.82 | 2Y+): Kids can find their rhythm and exercise their fine motor skills using the mallets to play the xylophone, cymbal, and guiro.', 'Fisher-Price Wood is available now at select Walmart stores and on Walmart.com. Title: Three American Girl Classics Are Back! Kirsten™, Addy™, and Josefina™ Return to Flagship Historical Line With Original Tribute Collections
Text: ['The brand’s grooviest girl — 1970s-era character Julie Albright™— also shines bright with all-new product collection and stories', 'MIDDLETON, Wis., May 13, 2024--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Today, American Girl, a cornerstone in the Mattel (NASDAQ: MAT) portfolio of purposeful brands, announced the re-release of three classic historical characters — Kirsten Larson™, Addy Walker™, and Josefina Montoya™— with special tribute collections that harken back to the brand’s roots. Kirsten, Addy, and Josefina (originally debuting in 1986, 1993, and 1997 respectively) remain fan-favorite characters that have inspired generations with their timeless stories that celebrate family and friendship, resilience in the face of change, and hope for the future. Now, these enduring characters are set to stir up a wave of nostalgia and inspire a legion of new fans with the debut of these three keepsake collections, featuring their original fashions and accessories, along with updated stories to bring the characters’ worlds to life in a fresh, relevant way.', '"As we look back on American Girl’s rich legacy, it’s our beloved historical characters and their powerful stories that have transcended the test of time—instilling in generations of girls and women an understanding of their own important place in the world," says Jamie Cygielman, General Manager of American Girl. "Through the return of such classics as Kirsten, Addy, and Josefina, along with new product and story offerings for our other timeless characters, like 1970s Julie Albright, we’re excited to continue engaging and inspiring American Girl fans of all ages for years to come."', 'The new throwback collections feature a signature 18-inch Kirsten, Addy, and Josefina doll that comes dressed in the character’s original debut outfit, along with her authentic introductory accessories. Arriving in a retro American Girls Collection™ box, each set also includes the character’s first paperback book in the series with vintage cover design and updated language, imagery, and resources to resonate with today’s readers. And, to celebrate birthdays through the decades, American Girl is also reissuing Kirsten, Addy, and Josefina’s original birthday party dresses and accompanying Happy Birthday books with original cover designs.', 'Additionally, for fans of American Girl’s beloved 1970s historical character, Julie Albright, there’s a new assortment of flower-power fun, including a totally retro school outfit and floral metal lunch box; a funky floral jumpsuit; a record player set with doll-sized records that play ’70s-inspired songs; and a fun skating outfit with lace-on shoe roller skates that really roll. In addition, American Girl Publishing released a new illustrated journal to tell Julie’s story of growing up in 1974 San Francisco. Told from the character’s perspective, Julie’s new journal format is a historical collection first, featuring full-color doodles and non-fiction back matter with details related to the story and era. The new illustrated journal will now come with the 18-inch Julie™ doll and is also available wherever books are sold. Additional illustrated journals and diaries for other historical characters are slated to debut in 2025 and beyond.', 'To further expand its storytelling, American Girl is also partnering with IDW Publishing to introduce a first-ever graphic-novel mystery series based on the popular historical characters. The first mystery—Julie and the Blue Guitar—is debuting this June, with a second book based on the late-’90s duo, Isabel and Nicki, releasing in spring 2025. More graphic mystery novels are planned to follow and will be available wherever books are sold. To support parents and educators, American Girl is also updating its free, downloadable discussion and teaching guides based on the historical character series in June 2024 at americangirl.com.', 'Fans can celebrate their favorite American Girl historical characters in person or online by:', 'visiting American Girl retail stores to enjoy a special Historical Character Birthday Teatime or Julie’s Groovy Painting Party at the signature cafes; book an appointment for a classic ’do at the Dolled Up Salon; explore new product and story collections, and more.', 'checking out American Girl’s TikTok channel and Instagram for fun historical character-themed TikTok trends, in-feed posts and stories, promotions, and book content.', 'watching new Julie-inspired videos starting in late May on American Girl’s popular YouTube and YouTube Kids Channel.', 'touring Addy, Josefina, Kirsten, and Julie’s rooms and exploring all the AG characters at the free Virtual Museum, and', 'learning more character background details on American Girl Wiki.', 'American Girl’s new tribute collections for Kirsten, Addy, and Josefina, plus the new Julie products and stories, are available now at americangirl.com and American Girl retail stores nationwide.', 'ABOUT AMERICAN GIRL', 'American Girl is a premium brand for girls and a wholly-owned subsidiary of Mattel, Inc. (NASDAQ: MAT, www.mattel.com), a leading global toy company and owner of one of the strongest portfolios of children’s and family entertainment franchises in the world. American Girl offers an inspiring world of dolls, content, and experiences that nourish a girl’s spirit and help develop her strength of character. Best-selling lines include Truly Me™, Girl of the Year™, Bitty Baby®, WellieWishers™, Create Your Own™, and American Girl’s classic historical characters. The company sells products through its award-winning catalogue, on americangirl.com, in its proprietary U.S. experiential retail stores, as well as at specialty retailers nationwide. By inspiring girls to be their best, American Girl has earned the loyalty of millions and the praise and trust of parents and educators. Title: The 3 Best Under $20 Stocks to Buy in May 2024
Text: ['For new investors looking for their first stock with limited cash, the low-priced stocks make sense as a starting ground. Though low prices, such as $20 per share, are more within reach of smaller retail investors, they are not exactly indicative of deep undervaluation.', 'To value a stock appropriately, investors should check valuation ratios, such as the trailing and forward price-to-earnings (P/E) ratios. Then, compare those against comparable plays or the industry average.', 'Of course, other ratios deserve some attention as you evaluate a firm. Of the following three stocks, two appear to be deeply undervalued. Let’s explore this trio, which may be an excellent choices for contrarians this May.', 'InvestorPlace - Stock Market News, Stock Advice & Trading Tips', 'Source: Ingus Kruklitis / Shutterstock.com', 'Warner Bros. Discovery (NASDAQ:WBD) has been quite a disastrous merger for investors who jumped into the stock at almost any point over the past year. At $7.80 per share, WBD stock certainly looks like a play that’s deep with value. Yet, the fundamentals seem to be fading, not just with Warner Bros. Discovery but the media industry as a whole.', 'Indeed, the bottom in the stock may still be a ways off for contrarians hoping for quick gain. The $19 billion company still has loads of debt, and the advertising headwinds have continued to weigh.', 'At this juncture, a merger with another distressed media firm seems like wishful thinking. Until now, the company has struggled to find a balance between growth and trimming costs. To keep up with the streaming heavyweights, one needs to spend a great deal. However, that will cut further into profits and limit debt repayments.', 'So, no easy answers are apparent for Warner Bros. Discovery. However, the stock looks incredibly cheap at 0.46 times price-to-book (P/B). At these depths, expectations may just be low enough to be worth the risk.', 'Source: NAN728 / Shutterstock.com', 'Known for its branded “Fun Ship” cruise line, Carnival (NYSE:CCL) stock has been cruising sideways since bouncing back modestly from its 2020 lows. Truly, demand for cruise lines has been picking up lately. But CCL stock has dragged its feet relative to its better-performing rivals. As the industry heals from the heavy hit of the pandemic, Carnival will eventually have the means to gain traction again.', 'Until then, Carnival has stood out as more of a budget option in a market that seems to favor high-end luxury players. CCL seems to be better suited for families and consumers with average incomes. Unfortunately, these folks have had inflation hit them quite hard.', 'On the plus side, Carnival’s latest quarter saw smaller losses than expected. However, it doesn’t look like CCL stock is going to hang onto the gains, with shares dipping more than 3% on Tuesday. In any case, CCL stock stands out as a relative bargain at 13.3 times forward P/E. At just over $14 per share, Carnival stands out as a great long-term bet for those bullish on a continued recovery in travel and leisure.', 'Source: Ken Wolter / Shutterstock', 'Mattel (NASDAQ:MAT) is the legendary toy company behind Barbie and Fisher-Price. Lately, the stock has been fluctuating wildly, with the stock down 26% over the past two years and around 60% from its 2013 all-time highs. Undoubtedly, MAT stock has been quite a long-time laggard.', 'And, while the Barbie movie jolt may be starting to fade, I do think the stock remains an attractive value option for patient investors. At $18.72 per share, Mattel is certainly an ideal first buy for a new investor looking for consumer brands.', 'About two weeks ago, Mattel reported a soft quarter in which revenue fell 1% year-over-year (YOY). Despite an unimpressive showing, the toy company saw notable strength in the North American market. Furthermore, the big three brands of Barbie, Hot Wheels and Fisher-Price posted decent numbers.', 'Moving ahead, earnings could begin to march higher as discretionary budgets improve. The stock goes for 13.2 times forward P/E, which may be far too cheap for so many legendary toy brands.', 'On the date of publication, Joey Frenette did not hold (either directly or indirectly) any positions in the securities mentioned in this article. The opinions expressed in this article are those of the writer, subject to the InvestorPlace.com\xa0Publishing Guidelines.', 'Joey Frenette is a seasoned investment writer specializing in technology and consumer stocks. Title: Mattel Appoints Karen Ancira Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer
Text: ['EL SEGUNDO, Calif., May 08, 2024--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Mattel, Inc. (NASDAQ: MAT) announced today that Karen Ancira has been appointed Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer for the company, effective May 15, 2024. Ms. Ancira will report to Ynon Kreiz, Chairman and CEO of Mattel.', 'Mr. Kreiz said: "Karen is an exceptional leader with a proven track record of cultivating purpose-driven, values-based Human Resources organizations and programs for major consumer brands globally. We look forward to the impact Karen will make to further inspire and engage our high-performing and collaborative workforce at Mattel."', 'Joining Mattel following 11 years with Yum! Brands, Ms. Ancira was most recently Chief People and Culture Officer, KFC, US and previously for KFC in Australia, Latin America, and the Caribbean. She also held senior Human Resources roles for the brand in UK and Ireland. From 2005-2012, Ms. Ancira served in HR leadership positions at PepsiCo in Monterrey, Mexico, creating and overseeing HR programs across Mexico, Latin America, and the Caribbean.', "Ms. Ancira brings to Mattel strong expertise in building progressive workplace cultures, fostering organizational development and effectiveness, and spearheading DE&I initiatives. During her tenure at Yum! Brands, Ancira developed a global leadership and character-building program that was implemented across the entire Yum! Brands portfolio. She also led the end-to-end HR agenda for the employee base, led the US organization through a leadership transformation, achieved 100% parity in gender pay for the US, and was instrumental in crafting and launching the business's transformation strategy.", 'Ms. Ancira added: "Mattel’s iconic portfolio is matched only by its passionate and committed global workforce. I have long admired the values of the company and identify deeply with the purpose behind its brands, and its relevance and importance to society. It is an honor to join this world-class leadership team to lead and enhance Mattel’s thriving culture and develop new People and Culture programs to help everyone succeed in this next exciting chapter for the company."', 'Ms. Ancira holds a BA in Economics from the University of Monterrey in Mexico and received an MBA from EAE Business School in Madrid, Spain. She is a member of the Board of Directors of the Latino Leadership Institute. Ms. Ancira will be based at Mattel’s global headquarters in El Segundo, California.', 'About Mattel', 'Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world.
